hypothesis: Image boundary and local context evidence distinguishes beneficial from harmful coordinate actions beyond the frozen geometry features.
stage: Train-scene-held-out learnability pilot, not official AP or novelty confirmation.

sample.selection: Sort each existing train/scene-holdout group by SHA256('visual-preflight-v1:'+stem); take fixed first N. Cached anchor samples and importance weights unchanged.

visual_input: 24 grayscale boundary/context features sampled at each cached action; no GT-derived features. Same input for visual regression and visual ranking.
geometry_input: Original 68 normalized geometry features; append 24 zeros for capacity-matched pilot controls.
normalization: Historical geometry train-only mean/std; new visual moments fit only on the selected training scenes.

recipe.conditional_repeats: Run seed0 first. Only if seed0 passes the small-pilot budget gates, run seeds1/2 on the same cached features.
recipe.selection: Final epoch only; no best holdout checkpoint or feature/margin tuning.

metrics: Importance-weighted sampled owned-anchor mean IoU, mean hit fraction at IoU0.50:0.05:0.95, harmful-move rate (IoU drop>0.01), and unowned move rate. Report all four arms and existing full-train frozen uniform on the same holdout.
interpretation: A positive visual-input effect permits a larger low-cost head experiment; visual ranking versus ordinary visual regression is a separate comparison. If visual ranking does not beat the existing frozen uniform, do not promote it to the strong control.
limits: Sampled fixed-reference targets are not detection AP/AR; independent pilot heads do not test complete detector seed robustness. Eight-epoch small-data failure stops this recipe, not all visual signals. Geometry padded controls have equal nominal architecture but inactive visual weights.
budget: Decode 384 train images once; reuse action cache. No detector inference/training, no test-dev selection, no official evaluation. Four small heads at seed0; at most eight additional small heads after a positive gate.
